world.wishes: Normal magic. Like fire, speed, water. Nothing like knots of destiny etc.

hero.name: Mr Magic
hero.powers: Fast in learning new magic. Already very strong
hero.heroLook: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots

quests.title: Restore the Spring
quests.detail: Find what blocks Karrowmere's spring in the hills.

summary: Mr Magic fought a weakened fire salamander at the red spring above Karrowmere, dived in, and froze the molten stone wedged in the vent. The water is freeing. Still to do: deal with the frightened salamander, finish clearing the vent, restore Karrowmere's water, and conclude by turn 50.

cast.name: Old woman
cast.look: elderly woman in her seventies, thin, weathered face, grey hair in a bun, faded blue shawl over a brown dress
cast.role: villager who asks the hero for help
cast.note: Begged the hero to save the spring.

cast.name: Fire salamander
cast.look: huge salamander-like beast larger than a horse, ember-glowing scales, thick tail, yellow eyes
cast.note: Starved of its fire when the stone froze; weak, frightened, may be calmed.

places.name: Karrowmere
places.detail: A timber-house village whose fountain has run dry; hills with a glowing red spring lie beyond.

places.name: Red hills
places.detail: Scorched slopes above Karrowmere, glowing red where the blocked spring lies.

places.name: The red spring
places.detail: A glowing, steaming pool in a bowl of black rock beyond the ridge.

places.name: Spring vent
places.detail: A scalding hollow beneath the red spring where a molten stone wedges the water channel.

facts: The spring in the hills is blocked by something fiery.
The scorched prints are wide, clawed and melted smooth, leading uphill toward the spring.
The salamander's heat is fed by something deep under the red spring's source.
The molten stone in the vent has been frozen and cracked; the spring's water can flow again.

recent.action: Freeze the spring's edge around it
recent.narration:
You rake your hand toward the spring and the water answers sluggishly. Ice crawls up the pool's rim, then shatters as the salamander's heat flares back. A burst of scalding steam rolls over you, blistering your arm and shoulder.

The beast drags itself closer, yellow eyes narrowed. The glow in its scales flickers, but it isn't out.

recent.action: Dodge and circle to the spring
recent.narration: You roll clear as the tail smashes the stone where you lay, then sprint low along the rim. The beast twists to follow, too slow, claws scrabbling on wet rock. You skid to a stop at the water's edge, the spring's heat on your face. Behind you, the salamander turns, sides heaving.

recent.action: Drench the spring's source with water
recent.narration:
You plunge the staff into the pool and pour everything into the water. It surges, a cold current driving down toward the glowing depths. The spring shudders. Far below, something hot and sullen hisses, and a pillar of steam erupts skyward.

Behind you the salamander shrieks, but it doesn't charge. It flinches from the cooling water, its glow guttering, yellow eyes darting between you and the pool. Whatever feeds its fire is down there.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, driving a wooden staff into a glowing red spring, a column of water surging down, huge ember-scaled salamander with yellow eyes recoiling in steam behind him, dusk

recent.narration:
You leap in while it flinches, staff raised high. But your boots slip on the wet rock and the blow lands short. The salamander snaps its head round and slams into your shoulder. You tumble across the stone, bruised and breathless.

It doesn't follow. It crouches by the spring, glow guttering, yellow eyes flicking to the steaming depths. It's afraid of what's down there, too.

recent.action: Dive into the spring after the heat
recent.narration:
You pull the water around you like a cloak and dive. The cold current drags you down through scalding dark, heat pressing at the edges of your shield.

At the bottom a vent opens into a hollow. A fist-sized lump of molten stone pulses in the channel, wedged tight, hissing and spitting at the cold. This is what blocks the spring.

Your cloak thins. Your lungs burn.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, underwater in a glowing cavern, wrapped in a shimmering bubble of water, facing a pulsing molten stone wedged in a rock channel, orange light, steam

recent.action: Freeze the stone with a focused blast
recent.narration: You gather the last of your breath and hurl cold into your palm, then loose it in one tight blast. Frost races over the molten stone. It screams, steam bursting around you, and your shield buckles. Then the stone cracks with a sharp crunch, its glow dying to dull grey. Water rushes past you through the channel, freed, and lifts you upward. A scalding splash catches your shoulder as you go.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, underwater in a glowing cavern, thrusting a hand at a molten stone in a rock channel, white frost and cracks spreading across it, steam and bubbles, orange light fading to blue
